# Saral Forge

> Saral Forge is a Sydney software studio that applies proven industry experience to websites, apps, automation and cloud systems.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://saralforge.com/): Studio overview, selected work and services
- [Services](https://saralforge.com/services.html): Websites, booking, automation, applications and cloud engineering
- [Work](https://saralforge.com/work.html): Illustrative problem patterns, not client case studies
- [Guides](https://saralforge.com/guides.html): Practical guides to websites, small apps and everyday business workflows
- [About](https://saralforge.com/about.html): Studio principles and approach
- [Start a project](https://saralforge.com/start.html): Project brief that opens the visitor's email app

## Accuracy

The project form does not transmit or store information on this site. Product information is not currently published.
